rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a short excerpt from audio, video, speech, or writing.

example.english: There is a really interesting snippet in this interview.
example.traditional: 呢段訪問入面有一小段講得幾精彩。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 fong2 man6 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 siu2 dyun6 gong2 dak1 gei2 zing1 coi2

rows.note: Use this for a small physical piece of something such as fabric or food.

example.english: I cut a small snippet of fabric to patch the hole in my trousers.
example.traditional: 我剪咗一小塊布，補返條褲嘅窿。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zin2 zo2 jat1 siu2 faai3 bou3 bou2 faan2 tiu4 fu3 ge3 lung1

rows.note: Use this when the snippet is a sample collected or shown for inspection.

example.english: The laboratory will take a snippet to check for contamination.
example.traditional: 實驗室會抽取一份樣本，睇吓有冇污染。
example.jyutping: sat6 jim6 sat1 wui5 cau1 ceoi2 jat1 fan2 joeng6 bun2 tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 wu1 jim5
